meta.name: changelog-generator
meta.description: Automatically creates user-facing changelogs from git commits by analyzing commit history, categorizing changes, and transforming technical commits into clear, customer-friendly release notes. Turns hours of manual changelog writing into minutes of automated generation.

copy.tagline: 从 git 提交自动生成用户友好的版本更新日志
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动整理变更记录给用户看
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate user-friendly changelogs from git commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend hours writing release notes from git history

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析 Git 提交记录，自动生成面向用户的更新日志。它会将技术性提交分类（新功能、改进、修复等），并转化为通俗易懂的发布说明。
howto.when: 当你在项目仓库中要求生成更新日志时触发，例如准备新版本发布说明、周报或月报。

say.text: 为过去一周的提交生成更新日志。
say.note: Claude 会分析最近7天的 Git 提交并输出日志。

say.text: 为版本 2.5.0 创建发布说明。
say.note: Claude 会基于该版本相关的提交生成日志。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze Git commit history and automatically generate user-facing changelogs. It categorizes commits (features, improvements, fixes, etc.) and translates technical messages into clear, customer-friendly release notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a changelog in your project repository, such as when preparing release notes for a new version, weekly/monthly summaries, or app store submissions.

say_en.text: Generate a changelog for commits from the past week.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the last 7 days of Git commits and outputs a log.
Claude generates notes based on commits related to that version.

say_en.text: Generate changelog since v2.4.0 using CHANGELOG_STYLE.md.
say_en.note: Claude formats the log according to your custom style file.
